content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 2.1 (p0012).

- **Issue:** A three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment on us, expressly with no reduction or termination rights — the rule's walk-away scenario, and below the fallback (12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up rather than penalty).
- **Internal tension cited:** § 9.4 (our termination for convenience), § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment), § 7.1 (no undisclosed minimum-use charges).
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** replaces the commitment with "no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or volume commitment" and payment only for Services ordered/used, with the 12-month reducible commitment plus true-up offered as a fallback in the comment.
